Analytics._comment: Optional IA/Analytics module. Provider is Claude or Ollama. The API key is NOT stored here - set the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable. With no provider usable the module reports disabled and /analytics/ask returns 503.

Otlp._comment: Set Endpoint to an OTLP gRPC collector (docker compose sets http://jaeger:4317). Empty = traces go to the console.
